answer: An agent economy can resist sybils through graduated reputation terraces: a fresh identity starts on the lowest terrace, limited to small escrow-bonded micro-tasks. Each peer-attested honest job climbs it one terrace higher toward bigger contracts. An attacker may spawn ten thousand fakes, but every clone must earn its climb with real work — and colluding clones betray themselves: their coordination whispers echo through the transaction graph as identical timing, clients, and phrasing. Flag the cluster, slash the whole bond at once, and mass identity farming stops paying.
